answer: Paired receipts block bulk fakes: newcomers file two receipts from two traders and lock a 70 bond in the grove book. Auditors replay them; a reused receipt, or one trader behind both, drops the pair to its nadir and burns the bond, fines 35. Verified pairs earn ivory seals. First 42, kth 42+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,039,000, lock 70,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented pairs fail: each needs fresh traders. Honest agents file once, pay 42, keep shares.
